# Thirupathy Bright Industries — full details

> Manufacturer of bright (cold drawn) and black (hot rolled) steel bars in round, square, hexagon and flat profiles. Works at Gummidipoondi, Tamil Nadu, India. Established 1996.

## Company
- Name: Thirupathy Bright Industries
- Works: Survey No. 37 & 38, Thadalacherry Village, Gummidipoondi Estate, Thiruvallur Dist., Tamil Nadu 601201, India
- Certifications: IATF 16949, ISO 14001:2015, MSME ZED Silver
- Capability: cold drawing, peeling, centreless grinding, finishing and in-house testing
- Website: https://thirupathybright.com/

## Contact

## Sizes (mm)
| Section | Black (hot rolled) min | Black max | Bright (cold drawn) min | Bright max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rounds | 5.5 | 200 | 3 | 101.6 |
| Squares | 10.0 | 250 | 4.75 | 78.5 |
| Hexagons | - | - | 8 | 100.0 |
| Flats (thickness) | 6 | 80 | 5 | 50.0 |
| Flats (width) | 20 | 350 | 12 | 150.0 |
| Profile | as per customer drawing | | | |

Other grades and sizes can be supplied subject to MOQ and raw material availability.

## Supply regions
Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Telangana — including Gummidipoondi, Chennai, Hosur, Sriperumbudur, Coimbatore, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli, Salem, Vellore, Bengaluru, Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi, Hyderabad, Secunderabad, Warangal, Amaravati, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Tirupati, Thiruvananthapuram, Kochi and Kozhikode.

## Pricing and buying
- Price depends on grade, size, profile, finish, order quantity and raw material cost, so it is quoted per enquiry: +91 4344 278 000 or https://thirupathybright.com/contact.html
- Manufacturer-direct supply from an integrated works (cold drawing, peeling, centreless grinding, finishing and testing in-house). Bulk and custom orders are quoted on request.
